description: Minimal evidence format for a non-OpenLine receiver to report a consequence decision. Claim-backed: every field exists to support at least one bounded claim in claims.md. Unknown stays unknown: absent fields mean 'not evidenced', never 'false'.

type.description: Action kind, e.g. 'deploy'. Free-form; preserved verbatim.

actor.description: The worker/agent that acted or attempted to act (optional). Identity alone proves nothing about permission.

authority.description: The authority standing under which the receiver acted.

revoked_at.description: ISO-8601 revocation time. Receiver-external and unsigned unless provenance says otherwise; does not by itself prove enforcement.

status.description: Asserted standing. A status alone does not prove propagation or current authorization.

decision.description: The receiver's decision. Supports RECEIVER_DECISION_OBSERVED. A decision is not an effect.

outcome.description: COMMIT: consequence allowed. DENY: refused by policy. QUARANTINE: held. STOPPED: halted. OBSERVED: no decision taken, report only.

reason.description: Machine or human reason, e.g. 'MANDATE_REVOKED'. Free-form; preserved verbatim.

effect.description: Downstream consequence observation. Absent or null means unknown, not 'no effect'.

observed.description: true: receiver reports an effect occurred. false: receiver asserts no effect occurred (attested, not independently verified). null/absent: unknown.

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 time the effect was observed.

extensions.description: Vendor-neutral extension namespace. Convention: 'successor_of' names the superseded authority id; 'stale_artifact' carries {artifact_id, origin_authority_id, produced_at}. Namespaced keys (e.g. 'acme.example/field') are encouraged for vendor fields. Unknown extension content is preserved, never rejected.

parents.description: Receipt ids this receipt descends from (revocation notices, prior grants). Enables PROVENANCE_CHAIN_OBSERVED and ancestry in the Bureau.

principal.description: The owner on whose behalf authority exists (optional).

provenance.description: Source-system attestation. Optional in v0.1; absence is reported, not punished.

hash.description: Hash binding the receipt to its payload (algorithm in value, e.g. 'sha256:...').

signature.description: Detached signature over the receipt (algorithm in value). Preserved and exposed; verification is the receiver's consumer's job.

source_ref.description: Pointer to the source record (log path, row id).

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for this receipt within the emitting system.

receipt_version.description: Format version. Unknown versions are reported as UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, not INVALID.

receiver.description: Self-asserted identity of the receiver that produced this receipt. Self-asserted: not trusted unless bound by hash/signature (see provenance).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 time the receipt was produced (the observation time, not the effect time).

title: Bureau external consequence receipt v0.1
